page_title: LEV 1-2 HOF | Bayer Leverkusen v Hoffenheim 23/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+1' Hoffenheim control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Bayer Leverkusen control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
88' Christian Ilzer is forced to make a change. Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) is unable to continue due to injury, Grischa Promel comes on.
87' The Bayer Leverkusen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
84' It's time for a substitution. Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on in place of Nathan Tella.
84' Erik ten Hag has decided to make a change. Claudio Echeverri (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Ibrahim Maza.
84' Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
84' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

82' It looks like Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) saw red with that tackle. Daniel Siebert won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Hoffenheim.

78' That was close by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
77' The attendance is 30000.
75' Christian Ilzer decides to make a substitution. Tim Lemperle will be replaced by Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
75' The substitution is prepared. Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Robin Hranac.
74' Bayer Leverkusen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
71' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) heads on.
71' The corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by the defence.
70' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
69' Looks like Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
69' Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniel Siebert blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
68' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim).
68' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
66' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
66' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) commits a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a free kick.
66' Bayer Leverkusen are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
64' Bayer Leverkusen control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
63' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.

61' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Another situation results in a direct free kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
61' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
60' Oliver Baumann comes off his line to intercept the corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen).

60' That's unlucky! Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
60' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner which is cleared.
55' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a rough foul. Daniel Siebert stops the game and makes a call. There is a free kick near the sideline to Hoffenheim.

52' 1 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Mark Flekken just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:2.
52' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
51' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
50' The Hoffenheim players are exchanging some short passes.
49' PENALTY APPEAL after Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
48' A player from Hoffenheim commits a rough challenge. Daniel Siebert blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
46' Half-time substitution. Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) is replaced by Umut Tohumcu.
46' Erik ten Hag makes a switch. Ernest Poku is coming on in place of Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' A corner kick by Hoffenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Mark Flekken (Bayer Leverkusen).

45+4' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the top right corner. Mark Flekken is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+2' Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
45+1' Koki Machida (Hoffenheim) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Arthur Chaves replaces him.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayer Leverkusen comes to nothing.

44' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the roof of the net, but Oliver Baumann is alert and denies him. Bayer Leverkusen will take a corner kick.
42' Koki Machida (Hoffenheim) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
42' It must be a yellow card. It is. Koki Machida (Hoffenheim) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
40' The resulting set piece from Hoffenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

40' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Mark Flekken. Hoffenheim get a corner.
38' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) was quite harsh and Daniel Siebert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Hoffenheim.
35' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

34' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the right side of the goal, but Oliver Baumann keeps it out. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
31' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
29' Hoffenheim hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
29' Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen get a free kick.

25' 1 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Bazoumana Toure, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim), who beats Mark Flekken with a brilliant shot into the top left corner. 1:1.
25' Dangerous play by Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen). Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Hoffenheim, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
24' Rough tackle by Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen earn a free kick.
18' Neat passing move from Hoffenheim in order to create new attacking opportunities.
18' Daniel Siebert interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen). Hoffenheim have a free kick.
17' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
16' The Hoffenheim players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
14' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Hoffenheim have a free kick.
14' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle as Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
13' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
12' Handball by Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim). Bayer Leverkusen will take a free kick.
12' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
11' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
10' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen will have a throw-in.
9' Koki Machida (Hoffenheim) picks up a rebound after a melee on the edge of the box. His first-time shot is poor, though, and curls well wide of the right post.
8' Hoffenheim take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
8' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Hoffenheim force a corner. They send men into the box.

6' 1 - 0 Perfectly taken free kick! Alejandro Grimaldo sends the ball in, Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) manages to jump highest near the penalty spot and plants a cracking header inside the right post. It's 1:0.
5' The referee blows his whistle as Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) was too aggressive in his challenge. Bayer Leverkusen win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
4' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
4' Koki Machida (Hoffenheim) makes a strong challenge and Daniel Siebert blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Bayer Leverkusen.
3' Great teamplay by Hoffenheim as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) accepts a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot towards the goal, but he only hits the left post! What an unlucky moment for him.
1' The first half has just begun.
Hoffenheim will kick-off.
Daniel Siebert got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
